title: Hal Saflieni Hypogeum Oracle Room tuned to 111 Hz

tellings.quote: And this place is precision tuned to 111 hertz.

plain: A man named Jay Anderson says the Oracle Room of the Hal Saflieni Hypogeum, an ancient underground chamber complex in Malta, is "precision tuned to 111 hertz", meaning its sound resonates at that frequency. He tells it as someone who has been there, and if true it would mean its ancient builders shaped the stone for sound on purpose.
